spec.title: Restic
spec.description: Restic backups: snapshot freshness and size per host, repository size, and maintenance. Metrics come from restic-exporter (k8s/platform/restic). Switch the datasource to VictoriaMetrics for history beyond Prometheus' 7 days.

spec.title: Newest snapshot age
spec.description: Time since each host's newest snapshot in the repository. Orange after 30h, red after 36h (ResticBackupStale's threshold).

spec.title: Repository size
spec.description: Stored size of every blob in the repository, after compression and deduplication (`restic stats --mode raw-data`).

spec.title: Compression ratio
spec.description: Uncompressed size / stored size of the repository's blobs.

spec.title: Snapshots
spec.description: Snapshots in the repository across all hosts, after the last forget/prune.

spec.title: Newest snapshot per host
spec.description: The newest snapshot of each host and path set. Size and file counts are what the backup processed, i.e. the size of the backed-up paths; data added is what it uploaded after deduplication and compression.

spec.title: Repository size
spec.description: Stored (compressed, deduplicated) and uncompressed size of the blobs in the repository. Drops after forget/prune.

spec.title: Backup size
spec.description: Bytes processed by each host's newest snapshot, i.e. the size of the backed-up paths. A sudden drop usually means data went missing from the source.

spec.title: Data added per backup
spec.description: New data the newest snapshot uploaded to the repository after deduplication. Held until the next snapshot lands.

spec.title: Backup duration
spec.description: Run time of each host's newest backup.

spec.title: Files new and changed
spec.description: Files the newest snapshot found new or modified since its parent snapshot.

spec.title: Snapshots kept
spec.description: Snapshots per host, and in the whole repository. Grows by one per daily backup and drops after each forget/prune.

spec.title: Blobs
spec.description: Unique data and tree blobs in the repository.

spec.title: Compression ratio
spec.description: Uncompressed size / stored size of the repository's blobs.

spec.title: Last successful maintenance
spec.description: Time since each repository's forget/prune/check CronJob last succeeded. kube-state-metrics only lives in Prometheus, so this always queries Prometheus.

spec.title: Locks
spec.description: Locks in the repository at each refresh. Host backups hold shared locks; one that stays well past the 02:00-04:00 backup window is probably stale, and maintenance's `restic unlock` removes it.

spec.title: Exporter refresh duration
spec.description: Time the exporter took to list snapshots and locks and read repository stats.
